featured_reviews.name: Khushbu Gaisota
featured_reviews.review_text: Pathetic experience, think 10 times before booking them. The rose petals were stale and old, I am attaching a photo of my varmala where you can see the old petals, also they were no where showered near the couple, it was far from where they were standing another poor experience. The wife of the planner was present throughout the event and nothing was done by her. We paid 20k for the host and she barely spoke 5 lines during the first half an hour of the varmala and then had disappeared for the rest of the day. We had wefast them with a custom sunboard and still they kept a tacky sun board provided for free by the banquet. They also had a very very bad DJ who played weird entry songs without consultation with any of the family members. The amount of sweet talks the son and father duo did with us while booking everything was very deceiving as we were given 10% of the service promised. The ownership was jot taken no refunds were made. It was overall a very bad experience for us at Grand Banquets Chembur. Please be aware and careful with the fraudulent promises from the planner

featured_reviews.name: Khushbu Gaisota
featured_reviews.review_text:
There were lot of hic ups, we asked for less intense smoke bubbles which was not followed. The rose petal shower was not happening over us but next to us, we had a runner and a host basically both were useless both didn’t inform he flower guy to come ahead to make petals fall on us properly. We customised the sunboard ourselves and made sure it reached them before hand but it was missing until we mentioned it to them to keep it, it had no flower arrangements around which were pre discussed.
The dj, runner and host were useless please avoid booking them with these guys. The dj played randomly “chote chote bhaiyo k badey bhaiya” on grooms entry without confirming with anyone, host said 2 lines during varmala and then she was no where to be seen utterly useless. The runner didn’t manage a single hic up or even noticed of it was happening. The wife of decorator was chasing us for the balance 20% throughout when our wedding was happening, instead of of putting in the energy to make the smallest of details right.
We had respected the quotation and didn’t push on any unrealistic negotiation.
We even paid everything on time, even though they were chasing us during the entire event, not realising or managing the goof ups that were happening in the background.
The things that were ruined for us was very miss managed and disappointing.
Additionally, the things that were discussed regarding the decor before hand were changed last minute without any prior intimation.
I am disappointed to have experienced all this as we had such good conversations with them at the beginning and went ahead with so much confidence. I think these things are important and shouldn’t be taken lightly before booking your decorator

featured_reviews.name: abhi santos
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you truly want your wedding day to be smooth and perfect, I strongly advise you to think twice before trusting Gautam Wedding Events.
My experience with them was extremely disappointing and caused unnecessary stress on one of the most important days of my life.

I had booked 50 “Pheta” pieces at ₹100 each for a 12 PM delivery, and this booking was done one month in advance. I even paid 50% advance to confirm the order.

But on the day of my wedding:
•	They completely forgot they had to come to my place.
•	Only after I reminded them did they say the exact Pheta I booked was not available.
•	They kept promising they would arrange the same colour, but from 10 AM to 1:30 PM, while my function had already started, they still failed to provide anything.

From my experience, it became very clear that:
•	They do not own their items — they borrow from others and pass it to customers.
•	They were highly unprofessional in handling something so important.
•	The people coordinating with us were immature and lacked basic manners or civic sense.

Because of their mismanagement and false assurances, my father was deeply hurt, as his only wish was that all the Baraatis wear Pheta — something we had booked well in advance.

Instead of fixing the issue, their only solution was “Take your advance back”, as if we could magically arrange 50 Phetas at the last moment.

I am writing this review so others do not go through the same embarrassment and stress.
Sometimes paying ₹100 extra to a reliable vendor is far better than risking your special day with careless and unprofessional service providers.

This was my genuine experience, and I hope it helps someone else make a better decision.
